Definition: to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter
BiblicalUsage: 1) to reproach, taunt, blaspheme, defy, jeopardise, rail, upbraid; 1a) (Qal) to reproach; 1b) (Piel) to reproach, defy, taunt; 2) (Qal) to winter, spend harvest time, remain in harvest time; 3) (Niphal) to acquire, be betrothed
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
